review.title: Brassica SynCom-NS: three bounded species-reference correspondences
review.independence_basis: The complete record and retained primary roster, preparation and host assay passages were read before staging. The parent independently read the authored source context, exact source inputs and both local and actual M5 candidate diffs. Another agent independently read the other two assigned source contexts in the four-record preparation. The shared native stage/apply/check/builder machinery was already independently reviewed and exercised end to end. This authored assessment is partial and technical, not a new full scientific review of the SynCom-NS record.
review.summary: Three existing SynCom-NS descriptors now retain native species-ID GTDB correspondences: Pseudomonas_E izuensis with five reference genomes, Ochrobactrum anthropi with 100 and rounded fraction 0.94, and Novosphingobium lindaniclasticum with two. The first and third fractions are 1.0. Source species/stock notes, unresolved Leifsonia and all biological claims remain unchanged. The actual guarded application, two native inline events, one native history sidecar and eight scoped native commands are bound; scientific issue 2891 remains explicit.
review.scope_description: Three selected taxonomy descriptors' GTDB blocks/statuses, source-stock versus reference-population boundaries, and actual application/history/check provenance. All other record claims are preserved without a new scientific approval judgment.
review.selection: CommunityMech:000476 is the single end-to-end application canary for four source-prepared whole records. Records 383, 387 and 449 remain unchanged while this canary is assessed, saved and its complete input namespace verified.
limitations: Partial technical and provenance diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Native validator success is not full scientific approval, source-snippet certification, aggregate QC completion or closure of unrelated source findings.

Primary coverage is the retained Methods 2.2-2.3, Table 1 stock roster and bounded host endpoint/Methods 2.5-2.7 context for PMID:42043130. This pass did not reacquire the article, inspect figure pixels, query sequence archives or exhaustively audit every scientific claim.

The three correspondences describe species-ID reference populations. Five, 100 and two genomes do not establish assemblies for SaPI1, SaOA1 or SaNL1 or measure their abundance in the inoculum/host. No exact numerator is inferred from rounded 0.94. The source stock names remain in notes; absent structured strain fields are not filled.

Pseudomonas_E and the Brucella/Ochrobactrum label difference are database observations. Native is_reclassified:true is not a formal nomenclatural ruling or study-stock reidentification. The current NCBI labels and primary-source synonym wording remain intact.

Leifsonia shinshuensis (NCBITaxon:150026) remains native-null and UNRESOLVED. Equal-volume standardized inoculation, individual physiological traits and host responses do not newly establish viable-stock persistence, member abundance or reciprocal microbial benefit.

Issue 2891 remains unresolved: the inspected whole-inoculum plant comparison, host biochemistry, transcriptomics and qPCR do not themselves establish the stored MUTUALISM/SYNTROPHY, all-member cross-feeding roles or directed GSH/HMA4 mediation. Those biological fields remain unchanged in this taxonomy-only correction; full relevant primary-source verification and a separate scientific disposition are still required.

The crosswalk SHA256 binds exact bytes but does not establish its upstream release or chronology. Native mapping_source reports file mtime only. Local NCBI authority rows retain file-stat provenance rather than a full database hash/release certification.

Local source preparation ran at 85d582fa with Python 3.13.12; actual M5 staging/application/checks ran at 14d95aa224ca0968a5008fb2b07b9500ce30f5bc with Python 3.13.2. Those executions retain their actual revisions and runtimes. The local/M5 candidate difference was only the two native event timestamps, independently reviewed before application.

The initial local offline install refused the nonexistent dev dependency group before installation; the native --extra dev path passed. Automatic review initially refused preparation publication, then accepted the same direct push after existing public-source and payload checks; no alternative publication route was used. These events are not validator passes.

The eight required commands are native history scaffolding and seven scoped validators. Source-snippet comparison, generated products, strict batch 133 successor admission and combined QC remain separate evidence requirements. Preserve every immutable old ledger/review and existing batch 133 successor while adding only an explicit 476 admission.

assessments.topic: Preserved SynCom-NS source stocks and host assay boundary
assessments.summary: Preserve the source's four-member SynCom and the three selected species/stock notes without inventing structured strain or assembly fields. SaPI1, SaOA1 and SaNL1 remain source identities; Leifsonia remains unresolved. The inspected host treatment context does not close scientific issue 2891 or approve reciprocal benefit, feeding or causal mediation.

assessments.topic: Three exact native species-ID reference populations
assessments.summary: The pinned full crosswalk and native resolver support the three encoded reference-taxon correspondences with populations 5, 100 and 2 and fractions 1.0, 0.94 and 1.0 respectively. Retain rounded-fraction and study-stock limits. Pseudomonas_E and Brucella/Ochrobactrum label differences are not formal renaming; the crosswalk release remains unestablished.
